# SEPTA Transit Alerts

> An unofficial public archive of SEPTA (Southeastern Pennsylvania Transportation Authority) service alerts and detected disruptions across SEPTA Metro, buses, and Regional Rail, with a rolling incident heatmap. Not affiliated with SEPTA.

A collector polls SEPTA's public APIs about every 10 minutes. Each incident is one real-world disruption: an official SEPTA alert (`official_alert`) and/or bot detections (`detections[]`: Regional Rail delays and cancellations, bus/Metro trip cancellations, and gaps, bunching, missing vehicles, and held vehicles inferred from live bus and trolley positions). The same data the site renders is published at stable URLs as JSON, CSV, and feeds, with no auth. Every incident has a `mode` of `metro`, `bus`, or `regional_rail`. SEPTA Metro routes use lowercase line codes (`l1`, `b1`, `b2`, `b3`, `m1`, `t1`–`t5`, `g1`, `d1`, `d2`); bus routes use SEPTA route ids with spaces hyphenated (`17`, `K`, `LUCYGO`, `L1-OWL`); Regional Rail lines use lowercase route codes (`pao`, `wtr`, `lan`, `med`, …). Timestamps are epoch milliseconds in JSON and ISO 8601 UTC in CSV.

## Data API
- [Recent incidents (JSON)](__SITE_ORIGIN__/data/alerts-recent.json): Every active incident plus everything first seen in the last 93 days. Top-level `incidents[]`. Poll this.
- [Archive index (JSON)](__SITE_ORIGIN__/data/alerts-index.json): Manifest of monthly shards (`alerts/<YYYY-MM>.json`) and per-line files (`incidents/by-line/<key>.json`); union the monthly shards for the full history.
- [Daily counts (JSON)](__SITE_ORIGIN__/data/daily-counts.json): Per-day Metro/bus/Regional Rail incident counts behind the calendar heatmap.
- [Accessibility outages (JSON)](__SITE_ORIGIN__/data/accessibility.json): SEPTA Metro and Regional Rail elevator outages, separated from the general incident archive.
- [Incidents (CSV)](__SITE_ORIGIN__/data/alerts.csv): Flat mirror, one row per official alert or detection, with an explicit `record_type` column.
- [Data changelog](__SITE_ORIGIN__/data/CHANGELOG.md): Changes to the data shape — check before pinning to the format.
- [Atom feed](__SITE_ORIGIN__/feed.xml) and [JSON feed](__SITE_ORIGIN__/feed.json): Recent incidents. Per-line/route feeds live at `/feed/line/<line>.xml`, `/feed/route/<route>.xml`, and `/feed/rail/line/<line>.xml`, each with a JSON-feed twin.
- [API catalog](__SITE_ORIGIN__/.well-known/api-catalog): Machine-readable index of these endpoints (RFC 9264 linkset).

## Pages
- [Homepage](__SITE_ORIGIN__/): Active alerts, network and line/route filters, daily summary, and the incident feed.
- [Calendar](__SITE_ORIGIN__/calendar): 12-month daily incident heatmap.
- [This week](__SITE_ORIGIN__/week): Recap of the current Sun–Sat week. Archived weeks live at `__SITE_ORIGIN__/week/<YYYY-MM-DD>` (the week's Sunday).
- [Stats](__SITE_ORIGIN__/stats): Worst day, worst hour, most-affected station, longest incident, Regional Rail cancellations and delays, plus year-over-year.
- [Compare](__SITE_ORIGIN__/compare): Side-by-side reliability for up to 3 lines or routes (`?metro=l1,b1` / `?buses=17,33` / `?rail=pao,wtr`).
- [Accessibility](__SITE_ORIGIN__/accessibility): Elevator outages and recent history.
- [Metro system health](__SITE_ORIGIN__/system/metro), [Bus system health](__SITE_ORIGIN__/system/buses), and [Regional Rail system health](__SITE_ORIGIN__/system/rail): Network-wide dashboards.
- SEPTA Metro line pages: `__SITE_ORIGIN__/line/<line>` (e.g. `/line/l1`).
- Regional Rail line pages: `__SITE_ORIGIN__/rail/line/<line>` (e.g. `/rail/line/pao`).
- Bus route pages: `__SITE_ORIGIN__/route/<routeId>` (e.g. `/route/17`).
- Station pages: `__SITE_ORIGIN__/station/<slug>` (Metro, e.g. `/station/8th-market`) and `__SITE_ORIGIN__/rail/station/<slug>` (Regional Rail, e.g. `/rail/station/suburban-station`).
- [All stations](__SITE_ORIGIN__/stations) and [all routes](__SITE_ORIGIN__/routes): Directories.
- Day pages: `__SITE_ORIGIN__/day/<YYYY-MM-DD>`.
- Event pages: `__SITE_ORIGIN__/event/<id>` (the incident id, e.g. `alert-136615` or `delay-2026-10-05-3556`).

## Notes
- Source code and field-by-field documentation: https://github.com/garlicbuffalo/septa-transit-alerts
- Full data schema: [/llms-full.txt](__SITE_ORIGIN__/llms-full.txt)
- Please be a courteous client: cache responses, don't poll faster than every few minutes, and credit the project if you build something public.
